name: Jamaica

categories.label: White number on your ship's space (-5 if on or before the -5 space)
categories.labelVi: Số trắng trên ô tàu đang đứng
categories.hint: Ending on or before the -5 space costs 5 points.

categories.label: Treasure cards minus cursed treasures
categories.labelVi: Kho báu trừ kho báu bị nguyền
categories.hint: Sum the printed values of revealed treasure cards; cursed ones are negative.

tiebreakers.description: Player furthest along in the race wins.
If still tied, victory is shared.

endCondition.description: A player reaches Port Royale after a full circuit; the current round is finished, then scores are counted.

notes: family: race-to-goal. Reaching Port Royale only ends the game; winner has the highest final score. Treasure card values are printed on the cards (not read). Two-player game adds a Ghost Ship (not scored as a player).
